title: Terrain sampling strata
description: Static sampling strata for the Ait Bouguemez valley catchment on the 10 m EPSG:32629 analysis grid: three equal-area elevation bands (below 2317 m, 2317 to 2815 m, 2815 m and above), aspect classes (north, east, south, west, level below 5 degrees) and an excluded layer (WorldCover 2021 cropland and built-up, 1.2% of the catchment). Strata organize field sampling; they are not vegetation types, pasture units or management boundaries.

providers.processing:lineage: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 2021 tile, bilinear to 30 m EPSG:32629, Horn slope and aspect, equal-area elevation terciles, aspect quadrants, level below 5 degrees; WorldCover 2021 classes 40 and 50 excluded Web-ready derived assets (elevation-band.png) are copies of the canonical GeoTIFF values written by science/pipeline/web-assets.py.

strata.title: Elevation band, aspect class and excluded layer

bands.name: elevation_band
bands.description: 1 below 2316.8 m, 2 from 2316.8 to 2815.2 m, 3 at or above 2815.2 m (equal-area terciles)

bands.name: aspect_class
bands.description: 1 north (315 to 45 deg), 2 east, 3 south, 4 west, 5 level (slope below 5 deg); Horn gradient on 30 m

bands.name: excluded
bands.description: 1 where WorldCover 2021 v200 is cropland (40) or built-up (50); shown as excluded, never as low vegetation

elevation_band_png.title: Elevation band 1 to 3 as an indexed PNG (web copy of band 1 of strata)

elevation_band_png_header.title: Header of elevation-band.png: CRS, transform, shape, palette

siterra:dataset.resolution_note: DEM 1 arc-second (about 30 m), strata repeated onto the 10 m analysis grid

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Count of 10 m analysis pixels whose centres fall inside the frozen polygon, EPSG:32629

parameters.aspect: quadrants centred on N, E, S, W

operation_order: reproject the DEM once to a 30 m EPSG:32629 grid aligned with the analysis grid (bilinear)
compute Horn slope and aspect on the 30 m grid
repeat the 30 m cells 3 x 3 onto the 10 m grid
split catchment elevation at its 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles
classify aspect into quadrants and level ground
flag WorldCover 2021 cropland and built-up as excluded

siterra:limitations: The DEM is a surface model: trees and buildings raise it; radar artefacts are possible in narrow gorges.
WorldCover 2021 is a 2021 context mask: it maps only 1.1% of the catchment as cropland, and much of the green valley floor is mapped as tree cover, which may include orchards.
Strata organize field sampling; they are not vegetation types, pasture units or management boundaries.

siterra:checks.name: attribution_present

siterra:checks.name: visual_inspection_sample
siterra:checks.detail: Rendered all three layers and inspected them on 2026-10-27 (science lane): slopes north of the river are classed south-facing and slopes south of it north-facing, as the valley's east to west axis requires; level ground follows the valley floor; the low band covers the valley floor and lower slopes and the high band the ridges and the southern lobe; the excluded layer lies along the valley floor
